definition: work that means handling forms and papers
description: An open-plan office. A woman in a rust-coloured blouse sits at a desk with a corded handset wedged against her ear, talking into it while she reaches for a pink sticky note and taps at her keyboard. Around her the desk fills up with towers of loose printed sheets and ring binders - one stack to her left, another rising in front of the monitor, more piling up until they reach above her head and box her in. Colleagues move about in the background. She stops, puts the handset down and slumps forward onto the desk between the paper towers.

en.question: What is piling up on her desk?

de.answer: Auf ihrem Schreibtisch stapelt sich Papierkram.
de.question: Was stapelt sich auf ihrem Schreibtisch?

es.answer: Se está acumulando papeleo en su escritorio.
es.question: ¿Qué se está acumulando en su escritorio?

fr.answer: Des papiers s'empilent sur son bureau.
fr.question: Qu'est-ce qui s'empile sur son bureau ?
